data.name: Close Weapon Mastery
data.description: When wielding a close weapon, she uses the unarmed strike damage of a brawler 4 levels lower instead of the base damage for that weapon. This must be declared before the attack roll is made.

raw_tokens.value: Brawler ~ Close Weapon Mastery
Special Ability
Brawler Class Feature.SpecialAttack.Extraordinary
When wielding a close weapon, she uses the unarmed strike damage of a brawler 4 levels lower instead of the base damage for that weapon. This must be declared before the attack roll is made.
